Title: Mayor Elsbeth Varr
Type: character
Entry status: canon
Aliases: Elsbeth Varr, the Mayor
Facts:
- Role: Mayor of Velmar and chair of the Harbour Council [canon]
- Age: 60 [canon]
- Sings with the Ashen Choir: Yes, at every full Ister [secret] (told by Ilsa Corran)
- Kept in: A drawer in the Tidehall [canon]
Body:
Elsbeth Varr, aged fifty-four, has been mayor of Velmar for eleven years and chairs the Harbour Council. She is calm, careful and rarely seen on the quay after dark.

# Pass 2: related entries (all facts, then prose)
## Entry ent_0002
<untrusted_data source="ent_0002">
Title: The Harbour Council
Type: faction
Entry status: canon
Aliases: the Council
Facts:
- Seats: Seven [canon]
- Meets at: The Tidehall [canon]
- Chaired by: Mayor Elsbeth Varr [canon]
Body:
The Harbour Council runs Velmar. Seven seats are held by elected harbour-wardens, and it meets in the Tidehall. Mayor Elsbeth Varr chairs it. The Salt Guild holds two of the seven seats and enforces the Law of Lanterns on its behalf.
</untrusted_data>

## Entry ent_0019
<untrusted_data source="ent_0019">
Title: The Choir Ledger
Type: item
Entry status: secret
Facts:
- Kept in: Ilsa Corran's crypt below the Tidehall [canon]
- Lists: Every member of the Ashen Choir [canon]
- Written in: A cipher of moon phases [canon]
Body:
The Choir Ledger is a book kept in Ilsa Corran's crypt below the Tidehall. It lists every singer of the Ashen Choir, and Mayor Elsbeth Varr is among them. It is written in a cipher of moon phases.
</untrusted_data>
